title: Zero locus of a section of a locally constant sheaf
statement: Let $T$ be a topological space (sheaves on $T$ are those on the site of open subsets of $T$ with open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]) and $F$ a sheaf of abelian groups on $T$ which is *locally constant*: every point of $T$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ such that the restriction $F|_U$ (the sheaf $W\mapsto F(W)$ on the open subsets $W\subseteq U$, with the restriction maps of $F$) is isomorphic to the constant sheaf $\underline A_U$ on $U$ of some abelian group $A$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For $s\in\Gamma(T,F)$ and $x\in T$ let $s_x\in F_x$ be the germ of $s$ in the stalk $F_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and let $Z(s)=\{x\in T: s_x=0\}$. Then $Z(s)$ is both open and closed in $T$.

proof.text: *$Z(s)$ is open.* Let $x\in Z(s)$. Then $s_x=0=0_x$, so by the description of equality of germs in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] there is an open $W$ with $x\in W$ and $s|_W=0$. For every $y\in W$ the germ $s_y$ equals $(s|_W)_y=0$, so $W\subseteq Z(s)$. Hence $Z(s)$ is open (this holds for every sheaf of abelian groups).

proof.text:
*Stalks of a constant sheaf.* Let $U$ be a topological space, $A$ an abelian group, $P$ the constant presheaf $W\mapsto A$ on $U$ (all restriction maps the identity of $A$) and $	heta:P	o\underline A_U$ its sheafification, so $\underline A_U$ is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. For $y\in U$ define $c_y:A	o\underline A_{U,y}$ by $c_y(e)=	heta_W(e)_y$ for any open $W
i y$; this does not depend on $W$, because $	heta_{W'}(e)=	heta_W(e)|_{W'}$ for $W'\subseteq W$ (the restriction maps of $P$ are identities and $	heta$ commutes with restriction). Claim: $c_y$ is an isomorphism of abelian groups. The germ map $\gamma_y:A=P(U)	o P_y$, $e\mapsto e_y$, is a homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]; it is surjective because every element of $P_y$ is a germ $e_y$ of some $e\in P(W)=A$, $W
i y$, and $e\in P(U)$ restricts to $e\in P(W)$, so both have the same germ; it is injective because $e_y=0$ means $e|_W=0$ for some open $W
i y$, and $e|_W=e$. (This is Stacks, Sheaves, Example 007B, $A=(A_p)_y$.) By [lem-weil-pbc-stalk-sheafification-space] (Stacks, Sheaves, Lemma 007Z) applied to the space $U$, $	heta_y:P_y	o\underline A_{U,y}$, $e_y\mapsto	heta_W(e)_y$, is an isomorphism. Hence $c_y=	heta_y\circ\gamma_y$ is an isomorphism.

*Local structure of $Z(s)$.* Let $x\in T$. Choose an open $U\ni x$, an abelian group $A$ and an isomorphism of sheaves $\varphi:F|_U\to\underline A_U$. For $y\in U$ the stalk of $F|_U$ at $y$ is $F_y$: the open neighbourhoods of $y$ contained in $U$ are cofinal among all open neighbourhoods of $y$, so every germ in $F_y$ is the germ of a section over an open inside $U$, with the same equality of germs [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. The morphism $\varphi$ induces the homomorphism $\varphi_y:F_y\to\underline A_{U,y}$, $\sigma_y\mapsto\varphi_W(\sigma)_y$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and $(\varphi^{-1})_y$ is its inverse, so $\varphi_y$ is an isomorphism. Put $t=\varphi_U(s|_U)\in\underline A_U(U)$. By Step 2 there is a unique $e\in A$ with $t_x=c_x(e)=\theta_U(e)_x$, and by the equality of germs there is an open $W$ with $x\in W\subseteq U$ and $t|_W=\theta_U(e)|_W$. For $y\in W$: $\varphi_y(s_y)=t_y=\theta_U(e)_y=c_y(e)$. Since $\varphi_y$ and $c_y$ (Step 2) are injective homomorphisms, $s_y=0$ if and only if $e=0$. So either $e=0$ and $W\subseteq Z(s)$, or $e\neq0$ and $W\cap Z(s)=\emptyset$. (Equivalently: on $W$, $y\mapsto c_y^{-1}(\varphi_y(s_y))$ is the constant map with value $e$, the local form of the blueprint's 'locally constant function $V\to A$'.)

proof.text: *$Z(s)$ is closed.* Let $x\in T\setminus Z(s)$ and take $W\ni x$ and $e$ as in Step 3. Since $x\in W$ and $x\notin Z(s)$, the alternative $W\subseteq Z(s)$ is excluded, so $W\cap Z(s)=\emptyset$, i.e. $W\subseteq T\setminus Z(s)$. Hence $T\setminus Z(s)$ is open, and with Step 1, $Z(s)$ is open and closed.

split_report.summary: Wrote the proof of the blueprint's Step 1 in four steps: Z(s) open for any sheaf (germ equality); stalks of the constant sheaf on a space are A via e -> theta(e)_y (Stacks 007B, with the Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-stalk-sheafification-space for 007Z); on a trivializing open U and a smaller W the germs s_y are all zero or all nonzero (transport of germs along the isomorphism F|_U = A_U); hence the complement is open. No new node: the blueprint's identification of s|_V with a locally constant function V -> A (Stacks 0081, no DAG node) is replaced by the stalk computation, which gives the same local constancy directly. Corrected the statement's citations: it cited def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves (sheaves on T_et) for 'locally constant' and def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image for germs; now cites def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology (site of opens), def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf and def-weil-pbc-module-stalk, and states that the group A may depend on U; meaning unchanged. stmt_deps updated accordingly. Mathlib: searched with LeanSearch, LeanFinder and grep; no match (Mathlib has only IsLocallyConstant.isClopen_fiber for functions). No slopmaster2 declaration found.
